notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myr tokens, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
